provenance.command: docker run --rm --network none -e GOTOOLCHAIN=local -e GOPROXY=off -e GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly -e GOMODCACHE=/modcache -e GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache -v <modcache>:/modcache:ro -v <git archive 981d25c go.mod go.sum internal pkg cmd/server, plus scratch in-package capture tests internal/gate/zz_fm11r16_capture_test.go and cmd/server/zz_fm11r16_tlsconn_capture_test.go>:/src:ro -v <out>:/out -w /src <image> go test -count=1 -run ^TestFM11R16 ./internal/gate/ ./cmd/server/
capture_notes: base ClientHellos come from Go crypto/tls clients over net.Pipe with a deterministic Config.Rand; variants rewrite those bytes
each stream is fed through captureConn.Read in exactly the recorded chunks, then read to EOF
done is captureConn.done after EOF; hello is the captured ClientHello or null
nondeterministic_in_go: tls13_sni_alpn stream bytes: the X25519MLKEM768 key share draws from the system RNG and ignores Config.Rand, so a rerun changes those bytes; every output derived from the recorded streams reproduced identically
provenance.scope: Frozen oracle outputs for differential parity only; never regenerate to hide drift
